lines.text: Apps open already built: the one under your finger in the ring starts loading before you let go.
Settings has 34 new choices (springs, clock, ask bar, island), and 12 old ones that did nothing now work.
Photos: Edit opens the new editor for a RAF. The one before is under Settings, Photos, Editor.
Astra plays many more formats; Music's queue can be edited and comes back after a restart.
